flame_dash: A man made of fire dashing to the right in profile, leaving a long trail of flames behind him.
storm_dash: A solid black silhouette of a man running to the right in profile, outlined by bright violet lightning, a long lightning trail behind him.
static_electricity: A raised open hand with thick violet electric arcs crackling between its fingers.
wave_slash: A huge thick white steel crescent slash wave flying to the right, a short motion trail behind it.
cyclone: A grey steel whirlwind tornado made of spinning sword blades, seen from the side.
ice_spike: A cluster of three tall jagged ice spikes erupting from the ground, the middle one tallest, a few ice chips flying.
ice_nova: a ring of sharp ice shards bursting outward in a circle
frost_tomb: a man frozen standing inside a thick block of ice
winter_disaster: a whirlpool of jagged ice shards spiraling into a dark center
frozen_orb: a glowing round orb of blue ice spinning, small sharp ice shards spraying out of it in a spiral
sacred_pillar: A narrow column of bright white holy light crashing down from the top edge onto the ground, a bright golden splash ring where it lands.
holy_pulse: Three thick concentric rings of golden light radiating outward from a small glowing white center, seen from above.
holy_light: A bright golden halo ring floating in the air, soft white light glowing inside the ring.
slicing_dash: A steel sword flying horizontally to the right on its own, blade pointing right, long thick white speed lines streaking behind it, no person, no character.
plague: A bone-white skull wrapped in thick green toxic smoke, flying to the right, a trail of green fumes behind it.
rise: A bone-white skeletal hand bursting out of a mound of dark earth, reaching upward, a faint green glow around it.
toxic_unleash: Seen from above: a thick ring of green toxic gas clouds bursting outward in a circle from an empty center.
rotting_gate: A round fleshy green portal open in the ground, a dark toothed maw at its center, green slime oozing over its rim.
putrid_curse: A sinister purple evil eye at the center of a glowing green magic circle seen from above.
advanced_necrosis: A rotting green heart with thick black veins of necrosis spreading over it.
elemental_projectile: Three small comets, one orange fire, one icy blue frost and one violet lightning, flying side by side diagonally toward the upper right, each with a short tapered tail.
spell_amplification: A glowing violet magic rune circle with a bright white upward arrow rising from its center, small violet sparks around it.
quick_strike: A single long steel rapier pointing diagonally up to the right, small gold hand guard, three thick white motion streaks behind it, no person, no character.
bloodlust: A single steel dagger pointing up, its blade covered in dripping red blood, a big red blood splatter burst behind it, no hand, no person.
trinity: A thin glowing white triangle with a small orange flame at its top corner, a small icy blue snowflake at its bottom left corner and a small violet lightning bolt at its bottom right corner, a white musical note in its center.
glyph: A glowing violet magic circle drawn flat on dark ground, a small orange flame in its center, six short white tick marks around its rim.
cauldron: A black iron cauldron on three short legs, bubbling with glowing violet liquid, a few round bubbles rising above it.
familiar: A black raven in flight with wide spread wings, side view, one glowing violet eye.
brazier: An iron brazier on three legs with roaring flames, spitting a fireball to the right.
fireball: A big round blazing fireball flying to the right, with a short fiery tail.
hell_snake: A slender orange fire snake in a big S shape seen from the side, head raised with mouth open.
immolation: A circle of tall flames seen from slightly above, a small dark human silhouette standing in the middle.
swift_bolt: A single thick jagged violet lightning bolt flying to the right, bright white core, a short trail of sparks behind it.
chain_lightning: Three small white skulls in a row, one jagged violet lightning arc jumping from the first skull to the second to the third.
storm_cloud: A round pale grey-white storm cloud with one thick jagged violet lightning bolt striking down from it. Isolated on a plain flat background, no sky, no ground, no horizon.
heavy_strike: A huge steel two-handed sword held diagonally, blade pointing up and to the right, a thick white curved swing arc trailing behind the blade.
cross_slash: Two steel swords crossed in an X, two thick white curved slash arcs crossing behind them.
spiral_sword: Three steel swords circling around an empty center, tips pointing clockwise, a thick white circular motion trail behind them.
judgment_chains: A short thick golden chain of four big links stretched diagonally from bottom left to top right, a glowing white iron hook at its upper end.
blessed_hammer: A golden war hammer with a heavy square head, spinning, a curved white spiral trail behind it.
flurry: Three thin steel rapier blades thrusting to the right side by side in a row, a short white speed line behind each tip.
throwing_knives: Three small steel throwing knives flying to the right in a fan, blades pointing right, short white motion lines behind them, no person, no character.
coup_de_grace: A steel sword plunging straight down through a thick white X slash mark, a bright white impact star at its tip.
counterattack: Two steel swords clashing in an X, a bright golden spark where the blades meet.
rat_bite: A grey rat head seen from the side lunging to the right, jaws wide open, two long sharp yellow incisors.
rat_tide: One big grey rat running to the right with a curling grey wave of fur rising behind it like an ocean wave.
hamelin_air: A bone-white transverse flute lying diagonally, three green musical notes floating above it.
danse_macabre: A grinning white skull with a crimson velvet beret, a steel rapier slashing behind it in a curved white swoosh.
contagion: A grey rat seen from the side with big green plague boils bursting on its back.
feast: A crimson banquet bowl overflowing with gnawed bones.
rat_king: A fierce muscular grey rat head wearing a golden crown, glowing green eyes.
